user_instruction: 这部分都你来做 一定要记住不要偏离我们的方向 明天我要直接看到这条线的结果

questions.RQ1_candidate_diversity: Do different retrieval contexts make the fixed 7B produce complementary correct answers?
questions.RQ2_answer_selection: Without gold answers, can runtime signals pick the reliable candidate better than a majority vote, without breaking correct answers?
questions.RQ3_adaptive_computation: Can an adaptive context budget reach the quality of a fixed budget with fewer extra generations?

base.note: B+BM25 (route 1 plus the P3-BM25 rule) is the baseline every comparison is made against; its answer is kept whenever the selection does not clearly choose another

fixed: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct NF4 (rev a09a354) is not trained. Selectors use runtime signals only; gold answers and judge labels are scoring targets on the sweep, never features.

contexts.definition: settings of configs/controller/l2_round_v1.json step_2_l2 (BGE top 100 and BM25 top 50 candidates, GPU cross-encoder); each context's answer follows P3-20 rules: build_c1_prompt, the shared generator, answer_rejection keeping C1, and the C1 answer when the Top-5 equals C1's
contexts.order_source: the first five were fixed as the 'diverse' set before any vote result was computed; the rest follow the grid order

normalization: answers group by baselines/_lib/answer_scoring.py normalize_standard; no other merging

policy_family.pre_gate: an item enters stage 3 when route 1 sends it to P3-20 or its stage-1 failure probability is at least theta (theta on a fixed grid including 0, meaning every item)
policy_family.stop: after each stage the item stops when the share of the largest answer group among C1 and the stage's context answers is at least tau (fixed grid); stage 8 always stops
policy_family.decision: at the stop, either the majority vote (B+BM25's answer kept unless another group is strictly the largest) or the logistic-regression selector of that stage, which switches to the candidate with the highest predicted correctness when it exceeds B+BM25's
policy_family.evidence_support: a passage supports a candidate when it holds the normalized answer as a token span (the answer_rejection grounding test), among C1's Top-5 and the stage's context Top-5s

choice.data: sweep 6,000 with 5 folds by sha256(sample_id) mod 5; every threshold and selector is fitted on training folds only and scored on the held-out fold
choice.rule: highest out-of-fold judge-assisted net against B+BM25 among configurations whose average extra generations are at most those of the fixed 5-context budget; within 3 items, the lower average cost
choice.final: the chosen configuration is refitted on all sweep items and committed before any confirm or Test answer is scored
choice.exploration_disclosed: fixed-K votes and selectors were already explored on the sweep (5-fold): vote K=5 +1.22 pp, logistic selector K=5 +1.92 pp, vote K=18 +1.80 pp against B+BM25

confirm.runs: the eight contexts' answers from the stored confirm candidates; route-1 and L2 confirm generations reused by (sample, Top-5)
confirm.rule: direction check: net of the chosen policy against B+BM25 > 0 to score Test

test.set: team Test 11,114, a further disclosed exposure
test.candidates: route-1 P3 items reuse artifacts/controller/bm25_gate_test_v1 candidates; the other items run l2_candidates.py --role test on the registered list below
test.runs: the eight contexts' answers for every Test item (l2_generate.py --data-role test); Test queries only, gold stays local
test.adoption: paired against B+BM25 on Test: judge-assisted net > 0 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
test.report: also net against C1, team RAG and the team product, the fixed 5- and 8-context votes, and average extra generations
test.labels: team qwen_only, team product, route-1 Test judge, the BM25 Test judge, the new batch, team RAG last (RAG wins on conflicts)

not_in_product: abstention; contexts beyond the eight; any rule fitted on confirm or Test
metric: judge-assisted correctness. Unchanged answers count zero.
